title: P18.5 — F10 deterministic numeric-ceiling enforcement (money/task-count/object-count) + test temp-dir lifecycle remediation (mkTmpDir factory, registry cleanup, stale sweep)
description: Two bounded workstreams on base 2174e91 (post-#154 main). F10: dimension-aware numeric ceilings on constraint requirements — ceiling{amount,kind:money|task-count|object-count,unit} extracted from EN/VI ceiling markers (at most/no more than/up to/max/tối đa/không quá/không vượt quá/nhiều nhất/không hơn/<=/≤) with grouped numbers; money ceilings also populate legacy maxAmount and are enforced via extended instructionAmounts ($/usd/vnd/đồng/dollar/euro) — declared amounts above the ceiling VIOLATE (fail-closed), at/below PROVEN, no evidence PRESERVED (never fabricated); task-count ceilings enforce plan task count; object-count ceilings enforce numbers bound to the same unit noun in task instructions; duration/frequency/percent units never mint ceilings; quantity.max on obligations enforced by contradiction via subject-bound numbers (no unrelated number may satisfy or violate); ceilings can never invert into floors. Runtime note: actual spending/API-rate enforcement is an execution-policy concern — plan-time inspection proves declared plan evidence only; unverifiable limits stay PRESERVED. Test infra: shared src/test-utils/tmpdir.ts factory (mkTmpDir registry + idempotent retry-tolerant cleanupTmpDirs + process-exit best-effort + age/prefix-allowlisted sweepStaleTmpDirs recovery), vitest setupFiles/globalSetup wiring, codemod of literal-prefix mkdtempSync callsites; measured before/after residual counts. No planner/canonicalizer/executor refactor; deterministic authority and fail-closed semantics preserved; zero new provider invocations; no auto-merge.
